site.title: X
site.short_description: Short posts and profile — bio link and post URLs for real-time reach.
site.long_description: X profiles can show one website in bio. Confirm rel on your public profile. Open profile settings.

opportunities.title: Personal profile link
opportunities.description: Use your main personal X account—the one you post from as yourself—and add your site in the Website field and/or bio. Good for founders who want one handle for you and your project. See customize your profile. Links are typically nofollow.

steps.body: Profile → Edit profile on x.com while signed into your personal account.
steps.title: Edit your personal profile

steps.body: Enter Website and optionally repeat in bio with context, then save per X Help.
steps.title: Add your URL

opportunities.title: Brand profile link
opportunities.description: Create or use a separate X account for your company or product—not your personal login—and set your marketing site in Website and bio before you post product updates. Outbound links are typically nofollow.

steps.body: Register or sign in to the X handle that matches your brand. Keep this login separate from your personal account.
steps.title: Create or switch to brand account

steps.body: On the brand profile, open Edit profile, enter your company site in Website, save, and confirm on the public profile.
steps.title: Add your business URL

opportunities.title: Tweet with link
opportunities.description: Share a post with your URL after your profile is set up. Post on X or schedule in OpenQuok when your X channel is connected.

steps.body: Write a concise post with your URL once.
steps.title: Compose the thread

steps.body: Post immediately or schedule in OpenQuok alongside other channels.
steps.title: Publish or schedule

opportunities.title: Reply with link
opportunities.description: Reply on X with a helpful comment and your URL when it fits—links are typically nofollow. On posts you publish, OpenQuok Auto plug post sends an automated reply with your link after your like threshold so you do not have to bump the post yourself. Set up plugs after you connect X.

steps.body: On X, reply to a relevant post with useful context and include your URL once when it fits the conversation.
steps.title: Reply with a helpful link

steps.body: On posts you publish, connect X in OpenQuok and attach plug (like threshold + reply with your link). OpenQuok publishes the reply when your rules match. Optional: reposts after likes for extra reach.
steps.title: Automate a follow-up on your posts
